policy.purpose: Keep product eligibility, fulfillment, output scope, revisions and rights distinct between Audio+ short orders and professional studio project routes.

publication.observed_statement: The service reserves the right to publish the result of the service on the service page unless the buyer expressly prohibited publication by unchecking the corresponding option when placing the order.
publication.nda_rule: NDA_RESTRICTED material must never be published. A general offer clause or default opt-out cannot override a specific NDA or confidentiality obligation.
required_owner_checks: Verify the exact wording and state of the publication checkbox in the live order flow.
Verify whether checkbox state is persisted and auditable per order.
Reconcile the generic publication clause with NDAs and individual order contracts.
Enforce a per-order publication prohibition for NDA_RESTRICTED material across portfolio pages, feeds, structured data, transcripts and AI/ASR outputs.

rights.observed_page_statement: transfer of author's and exclusive rights is listed among the service elements

non_equivalence_rules: A short-order Audio+ product is not a default destination or price basis for professional project routes.
Individual-buyer eligibility, a one-file workflow and short text limits must not be silently generalised to business project scopes.
A non-exclusive licence model must not be replaced by an exclusive-right transfer statement; the reverse transfer is also prohibited without source evidence.
A project page's list of service elements does not prove every item is included in every quote.
Do not infer PBX configuration, telephony routing or live system integration from a statement that audio files are prepared for upload.
The product-page edit option and offer restrictions on changes/rework remain an unresolved source conflict.

Offer clause 3.14's general publication-by-default wording must never be treated as permission to disclose an NDA_RESTRICTED order; specific NDA/confidentiality restrictions must be enforced per order.
Do not treat a homepage edit/correction option as overriding offer clauses 3.4, 3.5 or 3.8.1 until the product UI and published offer are reconciled in writing.
A publicly displayed price is not a verified current checkout price until the live order flow is tested and its scope is confirmed.
